name: HTML Blocks
description: Write styled HTML sections - cards, callouts, fancy lists, steps, timelines, grids and more - using a simple `!!! type` ... `!!!->` markdown fence.
author: madusanka

screenshots.label: The twelve admonitions, styled to match the Admonition markdown extension so existing notes migrate unchanged
The block picker: filter 383 blocks by name, id, colour or theme and insert one with a click
Charts drawn in plain CSS - columns, bars, pie, donut, line, area and gauges
Stat tiles, progress bars and star ratings
Tables and key/value data, in striped, bordered, compact and minimal styles
Big-text banners, gradient and neon headlines, outlines, 3D and rubber stamps
Fifteen CSS animations, all disabled again under prefers-reduced-motion

promo_tile.label: HTML Blocks - styled cards, callouts and lists from a simple markdown fence
